title: The outer Hom comparison for a tower binary open cover
statement: Use [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude], [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], [lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus], [lem-sp-tower-binary-ctf-fibre], the open-counit data of [def-sp-tower-binary-open-counit-data], and the exactness predicates of [def-sp-tower-binary-counit-predicates]. Fix h:Z→Y and c, a binary cover U,V, good K,P,Q, local representing counits eU,eV and preservation of good objects by compact support. Let G be good and aU:G|U≅P, aV:G|V≅Q, and fix e:F_ZG→K satisfying LiftEquations. Then the OpenThetaEquation identities hold on U,V,W, with the W counit restricted from U and its specified restrictionComp isomorphism. For every good M there exists delta making the canonical signed cover triangle distinguished; its A,B,A[1],B[1] are good; both HomFiveExact and ImageHomFiveExact hold; and the four OuterBijective comparison maps are bijective. The central map is deliberately not asserted bijective.

proof.text:
For a tower complex $M$ put $A_M=j_{W!}(M|_W)$, $B_M=j_{U!}(M|_U)\oplus j_{V!}(M|_V)$. The sequence-topos localization of [lem-pur-sequence-site-open-extension], with coefficient rings $A_n$, identifies these with the slice-topos operations. The constant subterminals $U,V$ cover the terminal sequence, as their union is terminal at every level, and their intersection is $W$. Clause (2) of [lem-sp-ringed-topos-binary-descent] therefore gives
$$A_M\xrightarrow{s_M=(1,-1)}B_M\xrightarrow{t_M=(1,1)}M\xrightarrow{\delta_M}A_M[1].$$
All these objects are in $\mathcal C_Z$ when $M$ is, by exact open extension from [lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus]; finite sums and shifts preserve the defining uniform intervals (take the union of the two intervals). The calculus makes $F_Z$ exact and identifies $F_Zj_{D!}$ with $F_D$, including the nested-open maps and counits.

source.place: Gluing paragraph: restriction pairs, compatible counit lift and five-term Hom comparison

proof.text: Fix any such lift $\epsilon$, and set $\theta_T(b)=\epsilon F_Z(b)$. For $D=U,V,W$ and any $N\in\mathcal C_D$, the open adjunction identifies a map $b:j_{D!}N\to G$ with $b_D:N\to G|_D$. Under $F_Zj_{D!}=F_D$, the lift equation identifies $\theta_{j_{D!}N}(b)$ with $\epsilon_D F_D(a_D b_D)$ for $D=U,V$. On $W$ the identical formula uses $a_U|_W$ and $e_P$, by precomposing the $U$ equation with the nested-open map. These are bijections by step 1, the assumed local representability, and the isomorphisms $a_D$. This applies also to $N=(M|_D)[1]$: exact open extension commutes with shifts, so it proves that $\theta$ is bijective on $A_M,B_M,A_M[1],B_M[1]$. For $B_M$ use the product decomposition of the Hom group of a finite direct sum.

source.place: Gluing paragraph: restriction pairs, compatible counit lift and five-term Hom comparison

proof.text:
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact] to the triangle of step 3 and its rotations. Clause (i) gives exactness at $\operatorname{Hom}(B_M,G)$, clause (ii) gives exactness at $\operatorname{Hom}(M,G)$, and clause (ii) for the rotated triangle $B_M\to M\to A_M[1]\xrightarrow{-s_M[1]}B_M[1]$ (whose $X[1]$ is $B_M[1]$) gives exactness at $\operatorname{Hom}(A_M[1],G)$. The reverse inclusions hold because consecutive composites in a distinguished triangle vanish. The resulting window is
$$\operatorname{Hom}(B_M[1],G)\to\operatorname{Hom}(A_M[1],G)\to\operatorname{Hom}(M,G)\to\operatorname{Hom}(B_M,G)\to\operatorname{Hom}(A_M,G).$$
Apply the same cited clauses to the image triangle under exact $F_Z$, with target $K$, for the lower window. Both rows are exact at their three interior terms; the shift isomorphism of the exact functor identifies $F_Z(A_M[1])$ with $(F_ZA_M)[1]$.

theorem open_hom_comparison
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hlp : l ≠ p)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p]
    (Z Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsSeparated Z.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Z.hom] [QuasiCompact Z.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    (h : Z ⟶ Y) (c₀ : Compactification h.left)
    (U V : Z.left.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (_hF : ∀ M : D l E Z.left, good l E b q Z.left M →
      good l E b q Y.left ((F l E b o c₀).obj M))
    (_hFD : ∀ (D₀ : Z.left.Opens) (N : D l E D₀.toScheme),
      good l E b q D₀.toScheme N →
      good l E b q Y.left ((support l E b o c₀ D₀).obj N))
    (K : D l E Y.left) (_hK : good l E b q Y.left K)
    (P : D l E U.toScheme) (_hP : good l E b q U.toScheme P)
    (Q : D l E V.toScheme) (_hQ : good l E b q V.toScheme Q)
    (eU : (support l E b o c₀ U).obj P ⟶ K)
    (eV : (support l E b o c₀ V).obj Q ⟶ K)
    (hU : Represents l E b q (support l E b o c₀ U) P K eU)
    (hV : Represents l E b q (support l E b o c₀ V) Q K eV)
    (G : D l E Z.left) (hG : good l E b q Z.left G)
    (aU : (restriction l E b o U).obj G ≅ P)
    (aV : (restriction l E b o V).obj G ≅ Q)
    (e : (F l E b o c₀).obj G ⟶ K)
    (he : LiftEquations l E b o c₀ U V eU eV aU aV e) :
          OpenThetaEquation l E b o q c₀ U eU aU e ∧
          OpenThetaEquation l E b o q c₀ V eV aV e ∧
          OpenThetaEquation l E b o q c₀ (U ⊓ V)
            (restrictedCounit l E b o c₀ (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U) P K eU)
            ((restrictionComp l E b o (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)).app G ≪≫
              (restrictionBetween l E b o (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)).mapIso aU) e ∧
          ∀ M : D l E Z.left, good l E b q Z.left M →
            ∃ δ : M ⟶ (shiftFunctor _ (1 : ℤ)).obj (coverA l E b o U V M),
              Triangle.mk (coverS l E b o U V M) (coverT l E b o U V M) δ ∈
                distTriang _ ∧
              good l E b q Z.left (coverA l E b o U V M) ∧
              good l E b q Z.left (coverB l E b o U V M) ∧
              good l E b q Z.left
                ((shiftFunctor _ (1 : ℤ)).obj (coverA l E b o U V M)) ∧
              good l E b q Z.left
                ((shiftFunctor _ (1 : ℤ)).obj (coverB l E b o U V M)) ∧
              HomFiveExact (coverS l E b o U V M) (coverT l E b o U V M) δ G ∧
              ImageHomFiveExact (F l E b o c₀)
                (coverS l E b o U V M) (coverT l E b o U V M) δ K ∧
              OuterBijective (A := coverA l E b o U V M) (B := coverB l E b o U V M)
                (F l E b o c₀) e
